title: Connect with INCY
hint: The link below adds every server to the INCY app. You install the app once — the setup guide is on its own page.
qrHint: Point a phone camera at it, or scan it from the app on a TV.
qrNote: The code carries your subscription link — keep it to yourself.
rotateHint: If the link reached the wrong hands, rotate it. The old one stops working immediately.
rotatedHint: Add the new link again in every app.
rotateConfirmBody: The current link stops working the moment you confirm. Every device you have added it to loses the connection until you paste the new one.

qrKindHints.url: The plain subscription URL — Hiddify, v2rayNG and INCY all read it.
qrKindHints.incy: The INCY deep link. Only INCY understands this one.

otherAppsHint: The same subscription. Add opens the app; if it is not installed, the link is already copied.
otherAppsDesktopHint: The same subscription. Copy the link and paste it into the app — the Add button only works on a phone or tablet.
